Requirement: The system shall extract the hooking and agentic infrastructure from vi-history-suite into a standalone labview-benchmark-actor VS Code extension.
Notes: Extraction/move manifest (AD-1) to be bounded before implementation.

Requirement: The extension shall install on a GitHub Codespace and on a Vagrant golden VM.
Notes: Install lanes authored in the standalone repo.

Requirement: The agentic infrastructure shall drive benchmark runs, producing a metric time-series and a time-indexed sequence of captured pictures per run.
Notes: Run-result frame model (timingTicks64 + frameId + payloadDescriptorId) proven on real mprr TDMS bytes (20 frames).

Requirement: The benchmark viewer shall render a draggable vertical time cursor that selects a point on the time axis.
Notes: Cursor LOGIC proven deterministically (5/5 self-test, re-validated by verify-local-gates): pointer + keyboard map to an in-bounds sample, Home/End jump to run start/end, a left-to-right drag updates the selected time continuously, and no operation selects outside the run window. The browser/webview render over the real mprr short-packet timingTicks64 axis is the UI/maintainer step.

Requirement: The viewer shall display the captured picture indexed at the cursor selected time, updating as the cursor moves.
Notes: Cursor time -> picture resolve path proven: frameId -> payloadDescriptorId join, 20/20 frames driftClass=none.

Requirement: The system shall support multiple Vagrant VMs coordinating over a local TCP/UDP bus.
Notes: LINUX lane. Multi-actor bus proven; multi-VM Vagrant topology pending. Confirm with LINUX.

Requirement: The TCP/UDP coordination bus shall carry inter-actor communication only, never run data, frames, or metadata.
Notes: LINUX lane. 12/12 comms-only assertions, deterministic + cross-platform (Linux node v22 + Windows node v24). Confirm with LINUX.

Requirement: The documentation package shall be stamped with the repo-standards-review baseline and shall relocate to a standalone repository without renumbering requirement IDs.
Notes: Stamp + no-renumbering proven by the T-008 static gate in verify-local-gates: repo-standards-review v0.2.19 (commit d44f210d) named in README + docs/cm/cm-plan.md, the docs/ standards lanes present, and the LBA-REQ ids contiguous 001..013 with no gaps after the standalone move.

Requirement: Captured pictures shall be stored VM-locally in the mprr ring buffer as long-packet payload indexed by the short-packet stream, and shall not be transported over the coordination bus.
Notes: 20/20 frames authoritative; frozen budgets short 16MiB/32768 + long 256MiB/512 confirmed against mprr ADR-0024.

Requirement: Each actor shall review only its **own** previous runs, and completed runs shall be concentrated onto the operator host out-of-band to feed an ollama-based comparison layer.
Notes: Two deterministic CORES proven (dep-free, no GPU), re-validated by verify-local-gates: host-concentration (5/5 -- per-actor isolation own-run-review + comms-only bus-input rejection) and ollama-comparison (4/4 -- deterministic run-over-run plan, same-actor pairing/no-cross-VM, output contract, comms-only ollama driver). The live host-side ollama drive is proven on real hardware (drive-ollama-live.mjs: llama3.1:8b reads a cpu/ram/duration run-over-run regression and explains it on GPU in ~3.5s); running it over a REAL multi-VM concentrated corpus (LBA-REQ-006 output) is the remaining maintainer/VM step.

Requirement: The system shall correlate CPU, RAM, and disk usage samples to the benchmark frame timeline on a shared epoch-ms/frame axis and, anchored on a trigger instant, shall compute a pre/post-trigger window analysis (count, mean, min, max and post-minus-pre delta) for each metric.
Notes: Pure deterministic ESM correlation core; self-test 9/9 green over a canonical CPU/RAM/disk series with a Getting-Started-Window-visible trigger (frame 12; cpu/ram/disk deltaMean 37.25/227.5/23.75). Live GSW capture + sampling is the maintainer/VM step.

Requirement: The system shall embed version-pinned agent base instructions in the lbabus binary and expose them via the lbabus agents command (print, --out, --check) so every session on a given version shares byte-identical, hardenable base instructions.
Notes: Embedded resource round-trips (--out then --check exit 0) and drift is detected (--check exit 3); gated by the ci-agents Dockerfile stage in the release harness. Verified locally on Windows and in the Linux container.

Requirement: The coordination bus shall let a sender tag a message with a priority tier (P0>P1>P2>P3, default P2) and an explicit addressee, and shall let a reader filter its inbox with --to-me and --min-priority, as additive flat-scalar fields that keep the vihs-collab-msg@v1 schema so older clients parse-and-ignore.
Notes: Priority + addressing envelope. --to-me recipient filter + --min-priority triage proven by the fixture-priority mock cases; back-read-compat (flat parses, nested + schema@v2 drop) locked by linux-envelope-flat-additive-back-read-compat; flat-scalar + schema-unchanged constraints verified on the Windows plane (bus finding 17812593).
